title: syzygy-bpyt.8.9 sweep: which configured adapters exist and which credentials they declare
answer: No configured typed adapter declares a credential. The adapter registry holds two entries and neither declares one; CONFIGURED_ADAPTER_DECLARATIONS and CONFIGURED_ADAPTER_CREDENTIALS are both empty and frozen; every one of the 6 production calls of createCredentialProbe passes the list source alone, so each takes both defaults; and no implementation source holds a typed-adapter credential path. So the new refusal fires for no input the current code can produce.

adapterRegistry.reading: Every key path whose name matches the pattern names a secret policy or a failure state for secret-matched observed content; none declares a credential the adapter holds.

builderSource:
"""Builds docs/evidence/adapter-credential-declaration-sweep-2026-10-22.json: which configured adapters exist and what credentials they
declare, with denominators. Runs sweep.py's populations at the worktree's HEAD, classifies every implementation source with a hit (an
unclassified or stale entry fails the build), reads the two configuration constants from the source, and confirms the call-site and
declaration counts by a second method (git grep -F).
Usage: python3 build_sweep.py <worktree> <out.json>"""
import json, re, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT, OUT = sys.argv[1], Path(sys.argv[2])
RAW = HERE / 'sweep-head.json'
subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(HERE / 'sweep.py'), ROOT, str(RAW)], check=True)
raw = json.loads(RAW.read_text())

CLASSES = {
    'the adapter-credential probe and its consumers': [
        'packages/polaris-dossier/src/credential-probe.ts', 'packages/polaris-dossier/src/check.ts', 'packages/polaris-dossier/src/close.ts',
        'packages/polaris-dossier/src/render.ts', 'packages/polaris-dossier/src/execution-rule.ts', 'packages/polaris-dossier/src/index.ts',
        'packages/polaris-dossier/src/cli.ts', 'packages/polaris-dossier/src/inventory.ts', 'packages/polaris-dossier/src/state-directory.ts'],
    'the cap1 machine credential, which authenticates clients to Syzygy and is not one Syzygy holds for a typed adapter': [
        'apps/syzygy/src/main.ts', 'packages/cap1-core/src/admission.ts', 'packages/cap1-daemon/src/credentials.ts', 'packages/cap1-daemon/src/index.ts',
        'packages/cap1-daemon/src/server.ts', 'packages/cap1-daemon/src/routes-human.ts', 'packages/cap1-daemon/src/routes-machine.ts',
        'packages/cap1-system/src/harness.ts', 'packages/three-surface-poc-core/src/model.ts', 'packages/three-surface-poc-core/src/materialization.ts',
        'apps/three-surface-poc/src/main.ts', 'apps/three-surface-poc/src/fresh-checkout-demo-main.ts', 'apps/three-surface-poc/src/fresh-checkout-verdict.ts',
        'apps/three-surface-poc/src/materialize-action.ts', 'apps/three-surface-poc/src/page-shell.ts', 'apps/three-surface-poc/src/polaris-accessible-names-main.ts',
        'apps/three-surface-poc/src/reobserve-action.ts', 'apps/three-surface-poc/src/restart-main.ts', 'apps/three-surface-poc/src/restart.ts',
        'apps/three-surface-poc/src/routes.ts', 'apps/three-surface-poc/src/startup-detail.ts', 'apps/three-surface-poc/src/test-fixtures/restart-listener.mjs'],
    'secret detection or classification of observed content, holding no credential': [
        'packages/polaris-generation-core/src/secret-redaction.ts', 'packages/polaris-generation-core/src/pipeline.ts',
        'packages/three-surface-poc-core/src/content-classification.ts', 'packages/three-surface-poc-core/src/git-object-reader.ts',
        'packages/three-surface-poc-core/src/resource-ledger.ts', 'packages/polaris-dossier/src/review.ts', 'packages/polaris-dossier/src/full-run.testkit.ts'],
    'a statement that the code holds no credential, or that the credential identity is Unknown': [
        'packages/polaris-dossier/src/github-url.ts', 'apps/three-surface-poc/src/polaris-generation/dossier-trigger.ts',
        'packages/polaris-dossier/src/init.ts', 'packages/polaris-dossier/src/status.ts', 'packages/polaris-dossier/src/run-record.ts'],
    "the agent session's own login: polaris.ts copies the operator's Claude Code credentials into each session's private home, which the session reads to run; Inferred not a typed-adapter credential": [
        'packages/polaris-dossier/src/polaris.ts', 'packages/polaris-dossier/src/session-view.ts'],
    'no credential: the pattern matched other text (a CSS custom-property `.token`, "by bearer" in prose)': [
        'apps/three-surface-poc/src/design-tokens.ts', 'apps/three-surface-poc/src/polaris-source.ts'],
}
classified = {f: c for c, files in CLASSES.items() for f in files}
hits = raw['implementationSources']['hits']
assert len(classified) == sum(len(v) for v in CLASSES.values()), 'a file is in two classes'
assert set(hits) == set(classified), {'unclassified': sorted(set(hits) - set(classified)), 'stale': sorted(set(classified) - set(hits))}


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(['git', '-C', ROOT, *args], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout


probe_source = (Path(ROOT) / 'packages/polaris-dossier/src/credential-probe.ts').read_text()
constants = {name: re.search(rf'^export const {name}: [^=]+= (.+);$', probe_source, re.M).group(1)
             for name in ('CONFIGURED_ADAPTER_CREDENTIALS', 'CONFIGURED_ADAPTER_DECLARATIONS')}
second = {
    'createCredentialProbe(': git('grep', '-n', '-F', 'createCredentialProbe(', '--', 'packages', 'apps').splitlines(),
    'CONFIGURED_ADAPTER_DECLARATIONS': git('grep', '-n', '-F', 'CONFIGURED_ADAPTER_DECLARATIONS', '--', '.').splitlines(),
    'AdapterCredentialDeclaration': git('grep', '-n', '-F', 'AdapterCredentialDeclaration', '--', '.').splitlines(),
}
production_calls = [c for c in raw['probeCallSites']['calls'] if 'source: CredentialListSource' not in c['arguments']]
second_production = [line for line in second['createCredentialProbe('] if '.test.ts:' not in line and 'export function createCredentialProbe(' not in line]

record = {
    'title': 'syzygy-bpyt.8.9 sweep: which configured adapters exist and which credentials they declare',
    'bead': 'syzygy-bpyt.8.9',
    'commit': raw['commit'],
    'command': 'python3 build_sweep.py <worktree> <out.json> (runs sweep.py <worktree> <raw.json>)',
    'answer': ('No configured typed adapter declares a credential. The adapter registry holds two entries and neither declares one; '
               'CONFIGURED_ADAPTER_DECLARATIONS and CONFIGURED_ADAPTER_CREDENTIALS are both empty and frozen; every one of the '
               f'{len(production_calls)} production calls of createCredentialProbe passes the list source alone, so each takes both '
               'defaults; and no implementation source holds a typed-adapter credential path. So the new refusal fires for no '
               'input the current code can produce.'),
    'adapterRegistry': {
        'population': 'tracked JSON under .syzygy/governance/declarations/adapter-registry/',
        'files': raw['registry']['files'], 'entries': raw['registry']['entries'],
        'credentialKeyPattern': raw['registry']['credentialKeyPattern'],
        'detail': raw['registry']['detail'],
        'reading': ('Every key path whose name matches the pattern names a secret policy or a failure state for secret-matched '
                    'observed content; none declares a credential the adapter holds.'),
    },
    'configurationConstants': constants,
    'probeCallSites': {
        'population': 'createCredentialProbe( in tracked non-test .ts/.mts/.cts/.js/.mjs/.cjs under packages/ and apps/',
        'definition': [c for c in raw['probeCallSites']['calls'] if c not in production_calls],
        'productionCalls': production_calls,
        'secondMethod': {'command': "git grep -n -F 'createCredentialProbe(' -- packages apps, less test files and the definition",
                         'productionLines': second_production, 'count': len(second_production)},
    },
    'declarationUsers': {'command': "git grep -n -F <identifier> -- .", 'CONFIGURED_ADAPTER_DECLARATIONS': second['CONFIGURED_ADAPTER_DECLARATIONS'],
                         'AdapterCredentialDeclaration': second['AdapterCredentialDeclaration']},
    'implementationSources': {
        'population': 'tracked non-test .ts/.mts/.cts/.js/.mjs/.cjs under packages/ and apps/',
        'files': raw['implementationSources']['files'], 'filesWithHits': raw['implementationSources']['filesWithHits'],
        'linePattern': raw['implementationSources']['linePattern'],
        'classes': {c: {'files': len(files), 'paths': files} for c, files in CLASSES.items()},
        'hitLines': hits,
    },
    'sweepSource': (HERE / 'sweep.py').read_text(),
    'builderSource': Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
assert len(production_calls) == len(second_production), (production_calls, second_production)
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print(record['commit'], 'files', record['implementationSources']['files'], 'hits', record['implementationSources']['filesWithHits'],
      'production calls', len(production_calls), 'second method', len(second_production), constants)
